title: Test with instanceof before you cast

blocks.text: A cast to the wrong type throws `ClassCastException`, so a value of unknown type is tested with `instanceof` first, and cast only when the test passes:
`instanceof` is `false` for `null`, so the same test also skips `null`.
Write `sum(List<Object> items)` in `Numbers`. It adds up every item that is a `Number` (`Integer`, `Long`, `Double`, ...), as a `double`, and ignores every other item:

cases.says: "two" is skipped, not cast: [1, "two", 3] adds up to 4.0.
A null item is skipped: [1, null, 2] adds up to 3.0.

concepts: A value is tested with instanceof before it is cast, so a cast never throws ClassCastException.
instanceof is false for null, so it needs no separate null check.
